title: Inferring Human Traits From Facebook Statuses
models_tested: Bag of Words (BoW) with l2 regularized Ridge Regression
findings: The study found that religious identity can be predicted from Facebook statuses with modest accuracy (54.1%). A binary classifier distinguishing religious vs. non-religious users achieved 78.0% accuracy. A detailed analysis of an Atheist vs. Agnostic classifier revealed significant gender bias; the model associated atheism with academic, male-coded words and agnosticism with positive, female-coded words, leading to higher misclassification rates for women. The authors demonstrated a method to mitigate this bias by encoding gender during training, which reduced disparate mistreatment without degrading performance.
